start.title: Söhne des Bodens
start.text:
Du bist Kain, der Erstgeborene Adams.
Dein Bruder Abel geht im Morgengrauen neben dir.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 4:1-2 — Cain and Abel were the first two brothers, sons of Adam and Eve.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] A quiet bitterness takes root.
[TODO:de] He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: Der Ackerbauer
fields.text:
Die Erde widersteht deiner Hacke.
Schweiß. Steine. Die langen Arbeitsstunden.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil while Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: Die Herde deines Bruders
abel_pasture.text:
Abel ruht zufrieden inmitten seiner Schafe.
Ein neugeborenes Lamm schläft auf seiner Brust.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 4:5 — Cain grew envious and downcast when God favored Abel.
[TODO:de] Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: Vor dem Altar
offerings.text:
Es ist Zeit, dem Herrn ein Opfer darzubringen.
Was wirst du geben?

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil, not his very best.
[TODO:de] Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: Die Gunst des Herrn
accepted.text:
Der Herr nimmt Abels Lamm mit Freude an.
Dein Opfer – das beachtet Er nicht.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You ask why. The answer is already in you.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:5 — Cain became very angry when his offering was not accepted.
[TODO:de] Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: Warum bist du zornig?
anger.text:
Dein Blick senkt sich. Deine Hände zittern.
Der Herr fragt: „Warum bist du zornig?“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:5-6 — Cain turned his face away and refused to answer God.

warning.title: Die Sünde lauert vor der Tür
warning.text:
„Die Sünde lauert vor deiner Tür.
Ihr Verlangen ist auf dich gerichtet – doch du musst über sie herrschen.“

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You exhale. You will choose differently.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:7 — Cain did not master the sin crouching at his door.
[TODO:de] The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: Komm mit mir aufs Feld
invitation.text:
Abel geht dir vertrauensvoll entgegen.
Sein Gesicht ist offen. Deines nicht.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 4:8 — Cain lured Abel out into the field.

field.title: Auf dem Feld
field.text:
Das Feld ist leer. Niemand wird es sehen.
Zorn steigt auf. Ein Stein liegt in deiner Hand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:8 — Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
[TODO:de] Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: „Wo ist dein Bruder?“
confrontation.text:
Die Stimme des Herrn findet dich.
„Wo ist dein Bruder Abel?“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
[TODO:de] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: Östlich von Eden, gezeichnet
wanderer.text:
Der Herr setzt ein Zeichen, um dich zu schützen.
Du musst weit weg von zu Hause wandern.
